note: The NWL storage map (openspec ide-model-mapping): one row per member and option the census holds, in the row format of design.md. picture, code and run compare the state with the editor's own form of the same box at the same place (where that form holds ??? and does not build, with the nearest building one); persists is `same` where the state was saved, closed and reopened and came back as stored. `not-measured` is never a guess: the row stays refused by name and is not counted as known. A row's fixture names the evidence: `box-states#<ids>` are states of box-states.3.5.21.40.json (CodesysBoxStatesTests offline, e2e nwl-box-states live), `box-states#fault:<i>` its filed faults. The gate is NwlMapTests.

statuses.lost-inert: held by the IDE, no text and no refusal: a pull shows another state's text; nothing builds or runs apart
statuses.refused-inert: refused by name; the code and the run are the same as the editor's form
statuses.refused-gap: refused by name; it changes the code or the run and has no text
statuses.refused-fault: refused by name; the IDE does not build it, or faults on it
statuses.cannot-store: the object model refuses to hold it
statuses.not-measured: not run; refused by name and listed
